title: Constitutional Capitalism — Three Eras Roadmap
stability_rule: Architecture frozen at CC-DEC-100/101 (stewardship). Chapter closed at UPD-056 under CC-DEC-102. Future changes require threshold gate. Momentum = execution of proof packets.

architecture_chapter_closed.closing_note: The credibility of Constitutional Capitalism will ultimately rest less on the originality of its ideas than on the transparency of how those ideas survive scrutiny.
architecture_chapter_closed.historian_closing_paragraph: The Architecture Chapter established the structure of Constitutional Capitalism. The Research Chapter begins the process of determining whether that structure is true, qualified, or should be revised. From this point forward, progress is measured not by the number of ideas created, but by the number of hypotheses honestly tested. The framework will earn credibility through transparent inquiry rather than assertion.
architecture_chapter_closed.next_chapter: Research Chapter — earn confidence one proof packet at a time

identity.text: Constitutional Capitalism's commitment to liberty, responsibility, stewardship, evidence, and transparent governance

examples: and every other architectural institutional design
hypotheses.rule: Identity should remain stable. Hypotheses must remain testable.

identity_vs_hypothesis.legitimacy_rule: If years later a proof packet concludes a doctrine should be substantially revised, the project gains legitimacy — because evidence decides refinement (Constitutional Symmetry).

era_metrics.research_era_rewards: increasing confidence in what already exists

eras.title: Era I — Creation
eras.objective: Discover, organize, test, and defend the Constitutional Capitalism framework.
eras.control: Everything remains under core editorial control.
eras.maps_to_phases: Phase 1 through Phase 7 (philosophy through education/publication packages)
eras.includes_current_work: Phase 2 proof burden, Burt forensic spine, modeling and legal foundations

eras.title: Era II — Review
eras.objective: Strengthen a mature document through structured external scrutiny — not write it.
eras.participants: Reviewers as contributors to scholarship, not co-authors

eras.title: Era III — Intelligence
eras.objective: Become a living analytical platform only after internal coherence and external review.
eras.ai_role: Engine for systems reasoning, consequence analysis, education, scenario exploration, and policy evaluation — not a source of doctrine.
eras.doctrine_ai_relationship: Doctrine becomes the source of AI reasoning. AI never becomes the source of doctrine.

current_instruction.to_burt: Return to Step 2. Build proof. Do not build Phase 8 or Phase 9.
current_instruction.to_architecture: Phase 8/9 sufficiently defined. Further capability capture only if it closes a proof or governance gap; default is freeze.

what_the_project_defines.process: How Constitutional Capitalism itself should evolve
what_the_project_defines.note: The five stages are a constitutional process for the framework, not merely a development plan.

constitutional_process.title: Five-stage constitutional process of the framework
constitutional_process.rule: Every stage has a different purpose and a different authority — preventing one function from dominating the others.

stages.purpose: Build evidence, legal analysis, and models

stages.authority: Systems Intelligence Engine (under human decision authority)

architectural_doctrines.title: Constitutional Symmetry (architectural doctrine)
architectural_doctrines.note: Not a new CC-PRIN-*. Captures how the project governs itself.
architectural_doctrines.text: The framework itself should operate according to the same values it advocates for society.

mappings.project_practice: every accepted change has a rationale
expertise is welcomed through structured review
claims advance through proof, not popularity
AI analyzes, reviewers critique, humans decide
every revision strengthens rather than destabilizes the system

scholarship_return.rule: Every proof packet should be capable of disproving the doctrine it examines.
scholarship_return.rationale: Phase 9 quality depends almost entirely on Phase 2 rigor. The best Systems Intelligence Engine cannot compensate for weak evidence.

architectural_freeze_point.title: Architecture has transitioned from invention to stewardship
architectural_freeze_point.mindset_now: Can we prove what we already have?

progression.question: How should it evolve without losing its integrity?
progression.status: answered by CC-DEC-100; freeze point CC-DEC-101

foundational_questions_answered: How is evidence separated from architecture?
Who has authority at each stage?
How does the system govern itself?

future_change_threshold.rule: Any future architectural change must meet a much higher threshold than adding another idea. Architecture may evolve when truly necessary — not by default.
must_answer_all: What deficiency in the current architecture does this solve?
Why can't the existing architecture accommodate it?
Which decisions would need to be revisited?
What new complexity does it introduce?
Does it strengthen or weaken Constitutional Symmetry?
future_change_threshold.approval: Requires explicit decision record addressing every threshold question; cannot be justified by novelty or architectural appeal alone.
